item: HATVP declaration of interests (déclaration d'intérêts), member of government
detail: As a member of the Lecornu government, Nuñez filed declarations of interests and patrimonial situation with the Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP). No outside professional activity, directorship or consultancy has been reported beyond his career as a senior civil servant; he is not reported to hold company directorships or significant private interests.
